name: PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk
summary: PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk offers sea transportation services in Indonesia. The company provides sea port services; domestic and international sea transportation, river and lake transportation, sea transportation in port waters; warehousing and storage; machine repair; and cargo handling services. It also offers vessel, freight, and fleet management services. The company was founded in 1960 and is headquartered in Jakarta Utara, Indonesia. PT Jasa Armada Indonesia Tbk operates as a subsidiary of PT Pelindo Jasa Maritim.
